### Description of Changes
Please include a brief summary of the changes and what problem or phase was addressed.

### Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (adding a new phase, visualizer improvement, or language syntax)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Code cleanup / refactoring

### Checklist
- [ ] Code compiles without warnings (`cargo check`)
- [ ] Code adheres to formatting (`cargo fmt --check`)
- [ ] Clippy checks pass (`cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`)
- [ ] Tested on sample `.t` files
